mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 0.1 percentage points over one month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 2% in one month signals a significant drop in consumer demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months indicates a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it reflects weakening economic activity and reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.5% in one month signals a rapid contraction in manufacturing output, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
